newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesians seize ecstasy haul from Singaporean.
newsitem.headline: Indonesians seize ecstasy haul from Singaporean.

text.p: Indonesian customs officials have seized 14,840 ecstasy pills from a Singaporean man trying to smuggle the drugs in his hand luggage through Jakarta's main airport, the official Antara news agency said on Friday.
The report quoted customs officials as saying the man, identified only as YWM, 35, was detained on Wednesday afternoon after arriving on a Thai Airways flight from Bangkok via Singapore.

The Jakarta Post daily quoted the Sukarno-Hatta airport's head of customs inspection Agus Wisnu as saying the man could be charged under the recently enacted Psychotropic Law for importing the drugs, valued at more than $267,000.
"If found guilty, he could face a maximum 10 years in jail and a 300 million rupiah fine," Wisnu said.
